teaching.one_liner: 42M plumber with chronic lateral elbow pain worsened by wrist extension and gripping tools.

must_ask.objective: Characterize the pain location and triggers
must_ask.say: Can you point exactly where it hurts, and does gripping tools make it worse?
How much repetitive gripping or wrist motion does your plumbing work require?

must_ask.objective: Assess duration and prior treatments tried
must_ask.say: How long has this been going on, and have you tried anything for it?

must_ask.objective: Screen for neck symptoms to exclude radiculopathy
must_ask.say: Do you have any neck pain or numbness going down your arm?

must_ask.objective: Explain the bracing and rehabilitation plan
must_ask.say: We recommend a counterforce brace, stretching exercises, and modifying your grip technique at work.
